name: Open Close
description: The second clip opens from the center as a circle, a vertical slit or a horizontal slit, or closes in from the edges (`shape`, `direction`). Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: shape
params.description: 0 = circle, 1 = vertical (opens left and right), 2 = horizontal (opens up and down)

params.name: direction
params.description: 0 = open (the second clip appears in the center and spreads out), 1 = close (the second clip comes in from the edges toward the center)
